title: Hebrew calendar (months numbered from Nisan) with the feasts marked
summary: The same Hebrew calendar with the months renumbered so that Nisan is month 1 and Tishri is month 7, ending with Adar as 12 and Elul as 6. Sukkot, Chanukkah, Pesach (Passover) and Shavuot are marked; there is no circle on this slide.

text.text: 7 Tishri (Sukkot 15–22) · 8 Cheshvan · 9 Kislev (Chanukkah 25–30) · 10 Tevet · 11 Sh’vat · 12 Adar · 1 Nisan (Pesach / Passover 14–22) · 2 Iyar · 3 Sivan (Shavuot 6–7) · 4 Tamuz · 5 Av · 6 Elul
